paragraphs.text:
It’s too risky to let Amelia go right now, so you decide to pursue 
her into the street. You don’t get more than five steps from the 
door before you find yourself staring Joshua down. Unblinking, 
he raises a gun at you, and the look on his face shows that he 
clearly intends to use it. You have only a moment to react.

• Make a Dodge roll: if you succeed, go to 112; if you fail, take 
1D10+2 damage. If you survive this, go to 155; however, if this 
reduces you to zero hit points, you have died. Your visit to Esbury 
is over. THE END.
